new_feature_requests.summary: Restore the frontend to its Version 8 state by reverting all changes made after Version 8. This includes removing any English text conversion changes, white-accent dark theme modifications, and any other improvements or alterations applied in versions 9 and 10. The site should look and function exactly as it did at Version 8.
